text: Hill and trifid work on groups of neighbouring letters, so one wrong, missing or extra carved letter anywhere could spoil their exact verdicts.

Every place changed to every letter, deleted, or with each letter inserted before it: 5,044 versions of K4, each through both exact tests; the Hill counts compared with the same on 10 scrambled copies (0152).
No trifid cube under any error. Hill: 257 living settings with a check on K4, all 5x5 with one check, fourth of eleven against the copies.
